links.comparator_used: High-autonomy agent (self-debugging, less rigidly engineered) vs low-autonomy, more strictly engineered agent configuration
links.outcome: Agreement of vancomycin dose recommendations with the treating pharmacist's order, and pharmacist-rated safety concerns among out-of-tolerance recommendations
links.effect: MAPE 21.8% (high autonomy) vs 37.8% (low autonomy); within 25% of order in 73.4% vs 50.9% of events (P < 0.001); safety concern more often with low autonomy (OR 2.37)
links.quote: A higher-autonomy agent that self-debugged its steps proved more robust than stricter engineering, but neither configuration is ready to dose patients without pharmacist oversight.

design_hint: comparing autonomy levels and inclusion of institutional guidelines
